title: TD-12 (RC2): no blank candidates in OFFER / ASK / OFFER_WORDS; advisory check FEP1-TD-SHOWN in Python, TS, Rust
notes: New RC2 rule TD-12 (spec 6.3, B row 3a, C rows, CHANGELOG): a 1.x trust layer SHOULD NOT list a blank candidate in shown of a text OFFER / ASK / OFFER_WORDS; a consumer MUST NOT offer one (drops it). Producer part version-gated like TD-9, consumer part every version. Advisory check FEP1-TD-SHOWN (warn, never reject) in Python / TS / Rust; TS + Rust profile failures() skip advisory checks. Consumer summary adds offered + advisories. DecisionTracker (TS, Rust) drops blank texts from offered and warns on 1.x. Vectors fep-0001 F55 (accept + warning), F56 (0.1, no warning); 56 now. Python = TS = Rust 283/283 vectors, 44,916 fuzz mutants (seeds 1-6, --n 30).
